units.caption: A new, empty project is open on NOTE MASKS for channel 1 before the first course action. No mask is set.
units.workspace:
Your starting point: Mosaic is running on norns with a 128 grid connected. Start a new project (PARAMS > MOSAIC > + New) so the course begins from an empty project. Have a MIDI instrument ready for chapter 2, or install and enable nb_polyperc before chapter 2 if you plan to use Polyperc 1 (see Norns Sound Sources with n.b.).

Learn the three objects

Know what a pattern, a channel and a song slot are for before you edit any of them.

Read these three ideas first. Nothing changes until the last line.

A pattern holds a rhythm of trigs (steps that play a note) and relative notes. You write patterns on the Pattern page.
A channel plays patterns through one sound: a MIDI instrument or a norns voice. Its masks are values that override pitch, velocity and length, for the whole channel or for single steps.
A song slot stores one section of the song. You arrange slots in chapter 9.

Then do one thing: tap Channel (3,8) on the grid to open channel 1.

MOSAIC / CHANNEL
Norns Sound Sources with n.b.

Select an installed supported n.b. voice for internal audio or Crow output.

Example
← MIDI Sound Sources
Device Parameters →
Captured examples
Controls

Install a supported n.b. mod to sequence internal sound sources or devices connected through Crow. Supported mods include:

nb_ansible for Ansible voices.
emplaitress offers four MI Plaits voices in parallel. Emplaitress's params can be locked in Mosaic. Emplaitress is sensitive to rapid notes. Check playback when using arpeggios, chords or small clock divisions.
nb_jf accesses multiple voice modes from Just Friends, including individual mono voice (with slew), polysynth, kit, and unison modes.
nb_crow for Crow v/8 and envelope functions.
nb_drum_crow turns a monome crow into a synthesizer.
nb_polyperc poly perc. Poly perc's params can be locked in Mosaic.
nb_rudiments percussion synth.
nb_doubledecker 2-layer synth. Doubledecker's params can be locked in Mosaic.
nb_oilcan percussion sync. Oilcan's params can be locked in Mosaic.

For nb_polyperc, install it through the Maiden Project Manager, or run ;install https://github.com/dstroud/nb_polyperc in the Maiden REPL. Restart norns with SYSTEM > RESTART so the installed mod is discovered. Then open SYSTEM > MODS, select nb_polyperc with E2 and enable it with E3. Restart norns again; Mosaic can then offer Polyperc 1 in the Device picker. One Polyperc voice is enabled by default. To add voices, open SYSTEM > MODS > NB_POLYPERC from the K1 menu, press K3 to open the mod menu and adjust E3. See the norns mod guide for the install, enable and restart sequence. Adding too many internal sound engines to channels can overload norns.

Try this step
Interactive examples
Recorded norns screen and grid
Choose an interaction
Select Polyperc 1
MUSICAL USE

Assign one internal voice and check playback. Add further voices before increasing chord density or arpeggio rate; multiple sound engines increase norns processing load.

Starting point: The Polyperc n.b. mod is installed and enabled in norns MODS. Channel 2's Device page is open and its player list is ready to browse. This channel carries the bass in the audio example Rhythm, bass and a changing chord.

Troubleshooting No Sound

Check transport, channel data and output settings in order.

Example
← Creating a First Loop
Creating a Phrase and Arrangement →
Captured examples
Controls

Use the loop in Creating a First Loop. Check the following in order.

Check that the grid playhead moves. If it does not, press Play. For an external clock source, check that the source is running and sending clock. Use the internal clock for a standalone check.
Select the intended channel and check that it is unmuted. Assign a pattern or enter trig masks. An unassigned source pattern does not play through the channel.
Check that active attacks are inside the channel range. If several patterns are assigned, check whether Skip removes their overlaps. Compare one assigned pattern or All trig merge.
Open Masks. Check Trig, Note, Vel and Len at channel and held-step scope. An explicit step value overrides its default. Velocity 0 is silent. Clear an exception to restore inheritance.
Open Device. Apply the selection with K3; a draft is not the active destination. For MIDI, match output port and receive channel. For n.b., check that the player is installed, enabled and supported. Check norns audio level and the listening path.

For hanging notes, stop playback, then hold a non-selected page navigation key to invoke panic. Panic sends Note Off messages but does not stop playback. A running sequence can sound new notes after the sweep.

The examples on this page each show one of these checks. Keep each channel independent shows that Device belongs to one channel, so a channel with Device None makes no sound (check 5). Keep a valid range when a gesture is reversed shows the channel range in check 3: a range gesture whose end would come before its start is refused, the previous valid range stays, and only the attacks inside that range sound. Merge two patterns shows how Skip removes the trigs two patterns share (check 3). Set velocity and length masks shows that velocity 0 is silent and that X lets the pattern's own velocity through (check 4). Create a four-step loop from an empty project is the working loop to compare against.

units.title: 1. Meet Mosaic
units.caption: You start from a new, empty project: transport stopped, nothing set up, channel 1 selected. Tap Channel (3,8), the third button on the bottom row. The screen opens NOTE MASKS for CH01 with eight cells (Trig, Note, Vel, Len and Chd1 to Chd4) that all read X: no value is set, because a new channel has no pattern, pitch or sound yet. On the grid, (1,1) is lit because channel 1 is the channel you edit, and (3,8) is lit because it is the page you are on.
units.outcome: Learn the three objects: The norns screen reads NOTE MASKS with CH01 in the title row. Its eight cells (Trig, Note, Vel, Len and Chd1 to Chd4) all show X, which means no value is set: the new channel has no pattern, pitch or sound yet. On the grid, (1,1) is lit because channel 1 is the channel you edit, and (3,8) is lit because you are on the Channel page. In chapter 3 you give channel 1 a pattern and a pitch.
units.workspace:
Your starting point: Mosaic is running on norns with a 128 grid connected. Start a new project (PARAMS > MOSAIC > + New) so the course begins from an empty project. Have a MIDI instrument ready for chapter 2, or install and enable nb_polyperc before chapter 2 if you plan to use Polyperc 1 (see Norns Sound Sources with n.b.).

Read the grid and norns controls

Be able to find any button from its coordinates for the rest of the course.

A grid position is written (column,row). Columns count from 1 at the left to 16 at the right; rows count from 1 at the top to 8 at the bottom. (3,8) is column 3 on the bottom row.
The bottom-left buttons open the main pages: Play (1,8), Record (2,8), Channel (3,8), Scale (4,8), Pattern (5,8) and Song (6,8). Row 1 selects the channel on the channel page, the pattern on the Pattern page and the song slot on the Song page.
On the norns, K1-K3 are the three keys and E1-E3 the three encoders, numbered as printed on the norns. "Tap" means a short press. "Hold K1" means keep K1 down while you act: it is the shift key.
Tap Pattern (5,8) on the grid to try a button. Chapter 2 starts by tapping Channel (3,8), so you can leave the Pattern page that way.

units.title: 2. Choose one sound
units.caption: Turn E2 down the list to Device, the eighth task (seven detents below Masks), and press K3. The title row reads DEVICE with CH01. Only the Device row is listed, set to None: the MIDI channel and MIDI port rows appear once you choose a device.
units.outcome: Open the Device page: The title row reads DEVICE with CH01. Only the Device row is listed, set to None: the MIDI channel and MIDI port rows appear once you choose a device. What you change here is only a draft until you press K3.
units.workspace:
Your starting point: New project, transport stopped, Record off. A MIDI instrument is connected and set to receive on a MIDI channel you know, or install and enable nb_polyperc before starting if you plan to use Polyperc 1 (see Norns Sound Sources with n.b.). Set the MIDI instrument volume before you start.

Choose the output and apply it

Make channel 1 play your instrument.

Turn E3 one detent to choose a Device. The first entry after None is CC Device, a generic MIDI device that suits any MIDI instrument. If your instrument has its own entry, choose that instead. With no external instrument, choose Polyperc 1 only if nb_polyperc is installed and enabled; see Norns Sound Sources with n.b. for setup.
The MIDI channel and MIDI port rows now appear. CC Device reads CC1 and OUT 1, so notes leave on port 1, MIDI channel 1. If your instrument listens elsewhere, turn E2 to a row and E3 to the value it needs. A device entry that fixes a value does not let you change it, and Polyperc 1 needs neither row.
Press K3 to apply. Until K3 the page only shows a draft and the channel keeps its old routing; K2 cancels the draft.

Merge two patterns shows how Skip removes the trigs two patterns share (check 3). Set velocity and length masks shows that velocity 0 is silent and that X lets the pattern's own velocity through (check 4). Create a four-step loop from an empty project is the working loop to compare against.

Norns Sound Sources with n.b.

Select an installed supported n.b. voice for internal audio or Crow output.

Example
← MIDI Sound Sources
Device Parameters →
Captured examples
Controls

Install a supported n.b. mod to sequence internal sound sources or devices connected through Crow. Supported mods include:

nb_ansible for Ansible voices.
emplaitress offers four MI Plaits voices in parallel. Emplaitress's params can be locked in Mosaic. Emplaitress is sensitive to rapid notes. Check playback when using arpeggios, chords or small clock divisions.
nb_jf accesses multiple voice modes from Just Friends, including individual mono voice (with slew), polysynth, kit, and unison modes.
nb_crow for Crow v/8 and envelope functions.
nb_drum_crow turns a monome crow into a synthesizer.
nb_polyperc poly perc. Poly perc's params can be locked in Mosaic.
nb_rudiments percussion synth.
nb_doubledecker 2-layer synth. Doubledecker's params can be locked in Mosaic.
nb_oilcan percussion sync. Oilcan's params can be locked in Mosaic.

For nb_polyperc, install it through the Maiden Project Manager, or run ;install https://github.com/dstroud/nb_polyperc in the Maiden REPL. Restart norns with SYSTEM > RESTART so the installed mod is discovered. Then open SYSTEM > MODS, select nb_polyperc with E2 and enable it with E3. Restart norns again; Mosaic can then offer Polyperc 1 in the Device picker. One Polyperc voice is enabled by default. To add voices, open SYSTEM > MODS > NB_POLYPERC from the K1 menu, press K3 to open the mod menu and adjust E3. See the norns mod guide for the install, enable and restart sequence. Adding too many internal sound engines to channels can overload norns.

Troubleshooting No Sound

Check transport, channel data and output settings in order.

Example

Controls

Use the loop in Creating a First Loop. Check the following in order.

Check that the grid playhead moves. If it does not, press Play. For an external clock source, check that the source is running and sending clock. Use the internal clock for a standalone check.
Select the intended channel and check that it is unmuted. Assign a pattern or enter trig masks. An unassigned source pattern does not play through the channel.
Check that active attacks are inside the channel range. If several patterns are assigned, check whether Skip removes their overlaps. Compare one assigned pattern or All trig merge.
Open Masks. Check Trig, Note, Vel and Len at channel and held-step scope. An explicit step value overrides its default. Velocity 0 is silent. Clear an exception to restore inheritance.
Open Device. Apply the selection with K3; a draft is not the active destination. For MIDI, match output port and receive channel. For n.b., check that the player is installed, enabled and supported. Check norns audio level and the listening path.

For hanging notes, stop playback, then hold a non-selected page navigation key to invoke panic. Panic sends Note Off messages but does not stop playback. A running sequence can sound new notes after the sweep.

Merge two patterns shows how Skip removes the trigs two patterns share (check 3). Set velocity and length masks shows that velocity 0 is silent and that X lets the pattern's own velocity through (check 4).
